"""Absence notices for parents."""

import rosterkit.attendance
import rosterkit.models


# ---
def absence_notice(student, marks):
    """Short text notice naming the student, days missed and the dates."""
    # Marks for another student must never end up in this notice.
    for mark in marks:
        if mark.student_id != student.student_id:
            raise ValueError(f"mark for student {mark.student_id} does not belong to {student.student_id}")
    days = rosterkit.attendance.days_missed(marks)
    if not days:
        raise ValueError(f"no absences for student {student.student_id}")
    dates = []
    # Dates come back oldest first, so the order is kept.
    for day in days:
        dates.append(day.isoformat())
    name = f"{student.first_name} {student.last_name}"
    return f"{name} missed {len(days)} day(s): " + ", ".join(dates) + "."


# end of file
EOF

import datetime
import unittest

import rosterkit.models
import rosterkit.notices

STUDENT = rosterkit.models.Student("1001", "Lee", "Ana", "A")


def mark(student_id, text, status):
    return rosterkit.models.Mark(student_id, datetime.date.fromisoformat(text), status)


class AbsenceNoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lists_absent_days_in_order(self):
        """Absent days are counted and listed oldest first."""
        marks = [
            mark("1001", "2026-09-10", "absent"),
            mark("1001", "2026-09-04", "present"),
            mark("1001", "2026-09-03", "absent")
        ]
        self.assertEqual(
            rosterkit.notices.absence_notice(STUDENT, marks),
            "Ana Lee missed 2 day(s): 2026-09-03, 2026-09-10."
        )

    def test_other_student_rejected(self):
        """A mark from another student raises."""
        marks = [mark("1002", "2026-09-03", "absent")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            rosterkit.notices.absence_notice(STUDENT, marks)

    def test_no_absences_rejected(self):
        """Nothing to write about raises."""
        marks = [mark("1001", "2026-09-03", "late")]
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            rosterkit.notices.absence_notice(STUDENT, marks)


# end of file
